**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** yes

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Event handler {name} expression is evaluated once at render (handlers bind once); wrap it in an arrow to re-evaluate it per event, e.g. `{name}={() => (cond() ? a() : b())}` or `{name}={(event) => handler()?.(event)}`
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Wrap the handler expression in an arrow so it is re-read per event: `onClick={(event) => (s() ? a : b)?.(event)}`.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
declare const s: any, a: any, b: any;
export const A = () => <button onClick={s() ? a : b} />;
```

```tsx prefer
declare const s: any, a: any, b: any;
export const A = () => <button onClick={(event) => (s() ? a : b)?.(event)} />;
```

## Quick fix

The [language service](../guides/tooling/language-service.md) (editor) and the MCP `check_code` tool offer this code action:

- Wrap handler in arrow function → `(event) => (<expr>)?.(event)`
